name: loom-workspace
description: Loom-managed workspace with AI development orchestration

scripts.check:ci: npm run lint && npm run test && npm run check:signoff-pins && ./.loom/scripts/check-xschem-embedded-quotes.sh
scripts.test: npm run test:compile && npm run test:unit
scripts.test:compile: find sim layout scripts -name '*.py' -not -path 'layout/.venv/*' -not -path 'layout/.venv-erc/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 python3 -m py_compile
scripts.test:unit: python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory layout/tests --pattern 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory sim/tests --pattern 'test_*.py' && python3 -m unittest discover --start-directory scripts/ci/tests --pattern 'test_*.py'
scripts.lint: find sim layout scripts signoff design spec -name '*.json' -not -path 'layout/.venv/*' -not -path 'layout/.venv-erc/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 python3 -m json.tool > /dev/null && python3 -m json.tool reuse.lock.json > /dev/null && find sim layout scripts signoff -name '*.sh' -not -path 'layout/.venv/*' -not -path 'layout/.venv-erc/*' -print0 | xargs -0 -n1 bash -n && bash -n loom.sh && ./.loom/scripts/check-dr-duplicate-numbers.sh
